namaes.name: Namaes
namaes.description: The Namaes has evolved the ability to tense its tail muscles and use its tail as a fearsome weapon.

norg.name: Norg
norg.description: This fish inhabits the shallows and feeds of crabs and other small crustaceans. When threatened it forces air into its brain to give it the impression of being much bigger than it normally is.
